title: The Interior Will Be Impermanent in the Future
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.187 Linked Discourses 35.187
  • 17. Saṭṭhipeyyālavagga 17. Sixty Abbreviated Texts

Ajjhattānāgatāniccasutta The Interior Will Be Impermanent in the Future

“Cakkhu, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ anāgataṁ …pe… jivhā aniccā anāgatā …pe… mano anicco anāgato. “Mendicants, in the future the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind will be impermanent …”

Evaṁ passaṁ …pe… nāparaṁ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
